summary: Greenland Mines Ltd filed an 8-K on June 17, 2026, reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with three investors on June 15, 2026. The company agreed to issue and sell 15,000,000 shares of its common stock at $0.25 per share for total proceeds of $3.75 million. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor was named. The closing is expected by June 25, 2026, and proceeds are for working capital. This is a routine private placement under Section 4(2)/Rule 506, not a special situation. No deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
